info.name: Lists all groups in the organization.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of groups to be returned. Limit can range between 0 and 1000, and the default is 100.

params.name: after
params.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `after` is a group ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with group_abc, your subsequent call can include `after=group_abc` in order to fetch the next page of the list.

params.name: order
params.description: Specifies the sort order of the returned groups.
